text: Anjali chupchap rasoi mein kaam kar rahi thi jab uski saas ne tana mara.
Bahu, tumhare maa-baap ne toh shadi mein ek gadi tak nahi di!
Anjali ne rone ki koshish roki, Maji, mere pita ji ek ordinary school teacher hain.
Saas ne gusse se bartan patka aur boli, Toh humne apne bete ki shadi is bhikaran se kyun ki?
Tabhi darwaze par ek kadak awaaz aayi, Kyunki us bhikaran ne meri company ko bankrupt hone se bachaya tha!
Sab piche mude, wahan Vikram, Anjali ka pati, gusse mein khada tha.
Vikram ne ek legal file table par zor se phek di.
Maa, yeh papers dekho. Anjali ek ordinary teacher ki beti nahi hai.
Wo us IT company ki secret investor hai jahan main as a CEO kaam karta hoon!
Saas ke hosh ud gaye, aur wo haklate hue boli, Kya... yeh sach hai bahu?
Anjali ne ek thandi muskaan di aur apna rasoi ka apron utar diya.
Haan maji. Aur kal maine wo company puri tarah se kharid li hai.
Ab aapka beta technically sirf mera ek employee hai.
Kamre mein maut jaisa sannata cha gaya, sirf Anjali ki payal ki awaaz goonj rahi thi.
